component.name: CosmicReDroid
component.summary: Native Linux Android Multi-Instance Control Center

description.p: CosmicReDroid is a high-performance native Linux Android multi-instance management suite designed for System76 COSMIC desktop environment, powered by ReDroid containers, hardware identity spoofing, and scrcpy display streaming.

ul.li: Automated Docker container lifecycle management for ReDroid instances
Deterministic multi-instance binder isolation and DRI GPU acceleration
Hardware spoofing with valid IMEIs, MAC addresses, and Android IDs
Copy-on-Write (CoW) instance cloning and zstd snapshot management
Integrated Image Factory for building custom ReDroid images
Host system diagnostics and automated permission remediation

description.p: Initial release of CosmicReDroid for the COSMIC desktop environment.
